operator: RegioTram de Occidente (Empresa Ferrea Regional / commuter rail)
notes:
RegioTram de Occidente is Colombia's first electric commuter rail (tren de cercanias), under construction; first phase (Facatativa-Fontibon) opens H2 2027, extension to Estacion Central (Calle 26 / Av Caracas) projected 2029. It reuses the former Bogota Savannah Railway (Ferrocarril de Occidente) western corridor. Because it is not yet operating, NO official clock timetable exists; only projected frequencies are published.

STOPS: All 17 stations are officially published and named (source: es.wikipedia RegioTram_de_Occidente station table with km markers + street addresses; RCN/El Tiempo/Gobernacion de Cundinamarca). No stops were invented. Ordered west->east: Facatativa (Cra 1, km39.5), El Corzo (RN50 km21, patio-taller, km35.8), Madrid 2 (Cl8 #7-8, km26.3), Madrid 1 (Cl8 #4E, km24.8), Mosquera 5ta Este (elevated, km21.7), Mosquera 1 (Cl5 #4-5, km20.8), La Ramada / Funza 2 (RN50 km3.3, km18.0), Funza 1 (RN50 km1.4, km16.1), CATAM (Av Cl22 #112, km11.6), Fontibon (Av Cl22 #96-97, km10.1), Av Ciudad de Cali (km8.5), Av Boyaca (km6.9), Carrera 68 (km5.2), Carrera 50 (km3.8), Carrera 40 (km3.3), Carrera 30/NQS (km1.5), Calle 26 / Estacion Central (Cra 17, km0.0).

COORDINATES: stop_lat/stop_lon interpolated along the corridor using the published km markers between geocoded anchor points (Estacion Central Calle26/Caracas, Fontibon Av Calle 22, CATAM, and the town centroids of Funza/Mosquera/Madrid/El Corzo/Facatativa from WebSearch). Bogota stations sit on Av. Calle 22 (Av. Ferrocarril de Occidente). Coordinates are approximate (station-siting precision +/- a few hundred m) but monotonic along the true alignment; none left null.

ROUTE: modeled as one rail line L1 (route_type=2), full corridor Facatativa<->Calle 26, both directions.

STOP_TIMES: end-to-end run time = 58 min (published: Facatativa->central Bogota in ~58 min once fully open). Inter-station times allocated proportional to km-marker distance with 30s dwells. Departures are SYNTHESIZED representative clock times (05:00, 07:00, 12:00, 18:00, 22:00 each direction) across a plausible 05:00-23:00 service span; the real timetable is unpublished. Published projected frequencies (not modeled as exact times): peak ~6 min Bogota-Funza-Mosquera, ~12 min to Madrid, ~24 min full to Facatativa; off-peak ~12 min.

CALENDAR: single "daily" service Mon-Sun, start 2027-07-01 (projected H2-2027 opening) through 2029-12-31. Service days assumed daily (typical for a metropolitan commuter line); official operating days not yet published.

CONFIDENCE 0.45: stops, names, order, alignment and end-to-end run time are well-evidenced from official/press sources; but the line is not operating, so clock times, exact per-station coordinates, precise headways-as-timetable, and service days are inferred, not from a real published schedule.
